description: A shell script used for testing Git diff-tree functionality with --max-depth, including setup, utility functions, and various test cases for directory traversal and depth limits.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates directories and writes a file with specified content.

methods.name: make_files
methods.description: Creates files and nested directories for git testing.

methods.name: check_one
methods.description: Performs a test to compare expected and actual output for specific diff-tree commands with max depth.

methods.name: check_trees
methods.description: Checks diff results for tree comparisons at various depths.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Checks diff results for index comparisons with various depths.
